title: Digits in Timer widget in edit mode are darkened even when Breeze global theme is in use
line: Desktop widgets keep their normal text colors while their edit mode handles are shown, instead of turning grey.
explanation: While a desktop widget shows its edit mode handles, ItemContainer disabled the applet so clicks would go to the container for dragging. In Plasma 6 the Kirigami Plasma style gives disabled items the disabled text color, so every widget's text (the Timer digits since they follow the color scheme, the Digital Clock, titles) turned grey. The change keeps the applet enabled and instead shows an invisible item above it in edit mode that takes hover, wheel and left presses (handing presses to the container, so dragging works as before), so the applet gets no input but keeps its colors.

commits.message:
containmentlayoutmanager: block applet input in edit mode without disabling it

Desktop widgets were disabled while their edit mode handles were shown,
so they switched to the grey disabled text color. Cover them with an
input blocker instead, which hands left presses to the container.

BUG: 512468

media.caption: Before: Timer normal (left) and with its edit mode handles shown (right): the digits turn grey
After: Timer normal (left) and with its edit mode handles shown (right): the digits stay white
Before: Digital Clock with its handles shown turns grey too
After: Digital Clock with its handles shown keeps its normal color

review.text: This fixes the real cause in the shared ItemContainer (disabling the applet gave it disabled colours) rather than patching the Timer alone. The blocker gets the same edit-mode condition and geometry sync as the old setEnabled, and the regression checks cover drag, click, wheel, right-click and normal mode. Touch press-and-hold relies on Qt's touch-to-mouse synthesis and wasn't tested on the rig. Worth a real touch check before pushing, since that path is mostly touch.
